method: Original code-authored pixel artwork drawn with Pillow; deterministic output, no third-party game assets.

assets.icons.png: 18 original 32-pixel technology, material and status glyphs
assets.wordmark.png: Retired authoring output; no longer installed in the game. Stencil-cut bitmap lettering rasterized from the project's licensed assets/mono.ttf
assets.slider_knob.png: Retired authoring output; no longer installed in the game. Original amber industrial fader handle
assets.plate.png: Retired authoring output; no longer installed in the game. Original procedural fallback steel frame
assets.plate_active.png: Retired authoring output; no longer installed in the game. Original procedural fallback highlighted frame
assets.plate_pressed.png: Retired authoring output; no longer installed in the game. Original procedural fallback pressed frame

materials: materials/materials_v1.png: generated inventory pictures (steel, concrete, scrap, ammunition) reduced by tools/build_material_icons.py. Generator, date, style reference, prompt, regions and hashes in materials/materials_v1.source.json; the original generated atlas is preserved as materials/materials_v1_source.png and excluded from export.
metal_panel: Retired generated texture; no longer installed. See metal_panel_source.json for preserved original generation metadata. The live UI uses code-authored UiArt steel grain and native styleboxes.
crafting: crafting/crafting_icons_v1.png: the generated workbench plan pictures (crafting/crafting_items_v1.png, kept for extension packs) reduced to 50 px pixel icons by tools/build_crafting_icons.py. Generator, prompt, regions and hashes in crafting/crafting_icons_v1.source.json.
